subject: M1 pack_loader CANDIDATE for gold sign-off
body:
M1 first-slice pack_loader is in rtl/native_ai/loader/ (NOT rtl/native_graph; A7 freeze).
CANDIDATE constants [§33.9]:
- ManifestHeader 128 B because §04 listed fields sum to 132 if reserved=16. CRC over [0:112), crc at [112:116), reserved 12 B = 0. Please confirm or freeze 132 B.
- magic NAI1 = 0x3149414E LE
- abi/manifest/schema version = 1
- CRC-32/ISO-HDLC = zlib.crc32
- RegionDescriptor 32 B as in §33.9
- Integrity labels this slice: FPGA_MANIFEST_ID_VERIFIED + FPGA_PAGE_CRC_VERIFIED + FPGA_SENTINEL_READBACK_VERIFIED. Not FPGA_SHA256_VERIFIED.

Please: (1) sign or patch the 128-byte header, (2) emit PACK_ABI_24 Python gold, (3) sign-off XSim vs gold. Vectors: python/m1/pack_vectors.py labeled CANDIDATE.
PROGRAM=NO. XSim != board.
